notes: Adds direct Streamer.bot WebSocket integration with a new Settings submenu above OBS, server testing, enabled-action loading, optional password authentication, and per-event action mappings.
Sends confirmed game launch, death, exit, level completion, achievement unlock, game-timer, hack-completion, and tracker-connection events without delaying live game polling.
Replaces the generic Settings symbols with colored Super Nintendo console, Windows file, NVMe, Streamer.bot, OBS, stopwatch, open-book, and notification-bell artwork.

Gives the main sidebar full-color artwork, uses the colored Super Famicom controller for Game Modes, and enlarges the supplied blue SMW Central storefront to match the other sidebar symbols with a transparent background and no unrelated Banzai Bill or lettering.
Shows a reliable in-app name box beside the pointer when any icon-only main sidebar item is hovered.
Gives all eight Game Modes dedicated color artwork and renames Difficulty Ladder to Difficulty Vine without breaking existing saved sessions.

Stabilizes RA-SNES/SNI live-memory samples before they reach the dashboard, preventing random deaths, temporary zero or inflated exits, save-slot timer jumps, and timeline movement caused by one inconsistent bridge reading.
Excludes SMW's pipe, door, and scripted-entrance actions from the retry-only death fallback, including transitions that return to the same room number.
Replaces the redundant dashboard Game Modes button with Finish Game Timer, positioned between Add to My Tracker and the far-right Complete Hack action.
Makes the Game Library RetroAchievements summary expandable into a scrollable list of every badge, requirement, point value, unlock state, and earned date for the selected game.
Makes the Overview RetroAchievements card expandable too, filling the Overview chart area with the same complete, scrollable achievement list and restoring the dashboard cards when collapsed.
Updates the live death counter before slower progress and OBS-file persistence work, reducing visible delay after a confirmed death.
Keeps the dashboard exit denominator numeric by retaining the selected library game's known total when an RA-compatible core or MiSTer reports the ROM path differently.
Centers MiSTer's native RetroAchievements popups and keeps descriptions on one line to prevent HDMI cropping in the visible 4:3 SNES area.
Hides MiSTer's persistent live leaderboard tracker during gameplay while preserving the final submitted-score popup.
Refreshes the Windows documentation with new Dashboard, Settings, and expanded RetroAchievements screenshots, replacing the older interface captures.
Publishes a Windows updater only; macOS remains untested and is not included in this release.
